name: redpen
description: Task contracts and independent evidence receipts for coding agents. Done is a claim; evidence makes it true.

interface.longDescription: Define what done means before Codex starts. Capture completion claims, independently run project checks, and return a PROVEN / FAILED / UNVERIFIED evidence receipt. Local Codex beta; no hosted service or semantic correctness judging.
defaultPrompt: Use Redpen to define done before fixing the pagination bug, then verify the work.
Check this coding task with Redpen and show which claims still need evidence.
Show the latest Redpen receipt and tell me whether it is still current.
